German

Etymology

Compound of aus +‎ ruhen.

Pronunciation

  • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

Verb

ausruhen (weak, third-person singular present ruht aus, past tense ruhte aus, past participle ausgeruht, auxiliary haben)

  1. (reflexive) to rest, to recover (through rest and relaxation)
    sich auf seinen Lorbeeren ausruhen ― to rest on one's laurels
  2. (transitive) to rest (one's eyes, etc.)
